entries.name: Oni
entries.content:
Oni are an entirely female species, often over six feet tall with superhuman strength. They typically have red or blue skin, but other colors such as purple and green are possible 

Oni are almost completely feral, with just enough intelligence to speak, band together and raid villages, and form some sort of community among themselves. They are known as raiders and rapists across the world, and human and elf men are warned to avoid leaving the protection of any village or city alone.
